test_router_retry_backoff_headers: test that router retry backoff uses the current exception headers not the initial ones
test_router_acompletion_with_retries: test the router acompletion method with num_retries set to handle rate limit errors
test_router_rate_limit_error_handling: test that router correctly handles RateLimitError exceptions with retry-after response headers
test_router_time_to_sleep_before_retry: test the router _time_to_sleep_before_retry method captures the correct exception on each retry attempt
test_router_make_call_mocking: test the router make_call method by mocking it to raise sequential RateLimitError exceptions
